exposure: Traditional umbilical trocar-first laparoscopic cholecystectomy (LC) using the Hasson technique
cohort: 244 patients with symptomatic uncomplicated gallstone disease and a history of previous abdominal surgeries extending to the umbilicus, undergoing laparoscopic cholecystectomy.
finding: The epigastric trocar-first approach significantly reduced total operative time, small bowel injury rates, conversion to open surgery, and postoperative pain at 6 hours compared to the traditional umbilical trocar-first approach.
